theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → 0 < n → R.Represents T → R.HasLocallyBoundedMeanCurvature → ∃ Θ : Euclid P → ℝ, (∀ x ∈ U, HasMassDensity T x (Θ x)) ∧ UpperSemicontinuousOn Θ U
